title: Psychological Steering in LLMs: An Evaluation of Effectiveness and Trustworthiness
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. It mentions that the TrustLLM benchmark evaluates fairness regarding stereotypes based on religion, but the results and discussion are focused on the effects of psychological steering (emotions and personality) on trustworthiness metrics in general, without breaking them down by specific religious factors.
